study.hypothesis: Observation, not mechanism proof: g2-r0067-native96_reference repeats AUC0.6675003890552496 with31,993,779 parameters, train328.1925s, inference26.1843s and model p50/p9515.0347/15.1563ms. g2-r0067-id12_fixed scores0.6670156484292077 (delta-0.0004847406260419), with28,606,531 parameters, train336.9757s, inference27.3491s and p50/p9515.2661/16.0824ms. The learned prefix12 cell scores0.6670237510876471, only+0.0000081026584394 over fixed, and spread12 scores0.667054275692386; none establishes prediction-cost utility. Loss is heterogeneous: the fixed12 history17..64 slice falls from0.6479074930839844 to0.6470497775053434, while history>64 slightly rises; these are exploratory aggregate slices, not a causal diagnosis. A compact table plus fixed matrix injection changes both capacity and operation-level rounding: FeatureEmbeddingDict calls a normal Embedding, whereas its new F.linear participates in host autocast. The provisional mechanism is that injection arithmetic or extra materialization contributes to the observed loss/cost; direct zero-padding removes the matrix lift without changing table rank, fixed coordinates or any host precision setting. Null alternatives are that missing ID coordinates dominate, or stochastic optimization/runtime noise explains the contrast. Broader trajectory review: all-field width12 in g2-r0024-joint_embedding12 lost0.00264236 from its own entry reference; residual-only reduction in g2-r0025-joint_residual_half lost0.00021707 without a speed benefit; shared projection reuse in g2-r0031-joint_projection_shared_reuse lost0.00230007 against its own parent. Recent dense-product replacement g2-r0066-dense96_product loses0.00026742 against native96 despite fewer dense parameters; the same-count energy change g2-r0064-energy_rank96_low changes AUC by-0.00009837. These successful executions with negative utility are separate branches, not failed runs or repeated-seed mechanism evidence. No previous_runtime_error is pending. This four-cell follow-up distinguishes capacity and implementation at rank12; it is established coordinate pruning/injection algebra, with no originality or external method effectiveness claim.
